modules.module_title: Facilitate and participate in the formation of CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs

pcs.pc_description: conduct feasibility assessment in the target village to determine the area and livelihood profile of the village, crops under cultivation and other details of livelihood
conduct business opportunity assessment to assess the strength of the village, agricultural production and marketing surplus, market conditions, collective marketing opportunities, etc.
carry out secondary research and primary research through focus group discussions
determine the indicative and actual price of the relevant types and different grades of produce from the appropriate markets and sources
select the business and revenue model covering what the entity will do, how it will achieve its business goals and build its revenue
prepare the economics of the potential commodities, including cost-benefit analysis, breakeven analysis, etc.
conduct risk assessment to assess risks related to production, produce quality and price, post- harvest handling/management, market access, marketing, etc.
identify the mitigation measures concerning the identified risks, e.g. risks associated with commodities
create awareness regarding CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs among the target communities, e.g. marginalized farmers, including women and mobilize them for their formation
analyze the post-farm-gate situation in the selected block before the formation of CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs
carry out the CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs pre- formation activities at the block level
facilitate the formation of CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs with the active participation of the target audience
assist in the formation of the management committee, including the selection of the president, secretary, treasurer, etc.
assist in opening an appropriate type of bank account for the CIG/FIG/SHG/PG
facilitate business ideas generation, the building of business framework, including business model, select financials, risk assessment and such other incidentals for the group
ensure fair sharing of resources, labor, and profits
follow transparent practices in contribution and benefit distribution
work towards collective productivity rather than individual gains

modules.module_title: Facilitate and participate in the operations of CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs

pcs.pc_description: regularly attend group meetings, training, and decision-making sessions
address disputes within the group constructively
respect collective decisions even if they differ from personal preferences
promote solidarity and mutual support among members
contribute timely towards group funds, input costs, or maintenance charges
undertake promotional activities for CIG/FIG/SHG/PG
assist in establishing a Village Level Aggregation Centre (VLAC) to store the group assets and facilitate aggregation of produce at a common point
assist the CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs in collective procurement and marketing of farm produce
identify and assist the group in utilizing the relevant convergence opportunities
coordinate with the relevant authorities to organize appropriate training programs and exposure visits for group members to help them learn new skills and use of latest technologies
ensure rotation of the management committee at an appropriate interval to allow all members to assume leadership roles in the committee
ensure the maintenance of books of accounts, e.g. cash book, daily business register, member ledger, assets register etc., for the group
ensure the preparation of operating profit and loss statement for every business cycle as per the business plan
track contributions and benefits shared among members
facilitate the conversion of CIGs/FIGs/SHGs/PGs into legal entities, e.g. co- operatives, producer companies, trusts, Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs), etc.
comply with government schemes, FPO guidelines, and cooperative norms

modules.module_title: Perform harvesting and post-harvest management of the produce

pcs.pc_description: check the crop to ensure crop it is physiologically mature before being harvested
harvest the produce using the appropriate tool, equipment and implements
arrange for pre-cooling the harvested produce at the recommended temperature to remove the field heat
ensure drying of produce to reduce moisture content level to the appropriate levels
arrange for cleaning, sorting and grading of the harvested produce
arrange the appropriate type of packing material according to the type of produce and ensure safe and hygienic packaging of the produce
select an appropriate storage area for storing the produce, ensuring it is free from pests, diseases, predators, water leakage/moisture, etc.
arrange for the storage area to be sanitized, and the application of appropriate treatment(s) to eliminate pests and diseases, as required
ensure the produce is stored using the appropriate accessories and aids, such as pallets and crates
follow the recommended storage methods, e.g. avoiding to stack heavy produce sacks over others to prevent damage or loss of produce in the sacks underneath
ensure the same kind of produce is stored together, avoiding mixing produce in the storage
check and ensure no toxic materials, e.g. pesticides, are stored in the storage with the produce
maintain the recommended levels of temperature and relative humidity in the storage area, according to the type of produce
ensure the use of appropriate tools and equipment for handling the produce to avoid any damage to the produce and packing material
follow the recommended health and safety practices to prevent the microbial build-up
arrange the appropriate transport method for transporting the produce to the relevant markets, such as refrigerated trucks to transport fresh produce
ensure the produce is arranged appropriately in the transport vehicle
arrange for timely transportation of produce to the relevant markets/ consumers without affecting the quality of produce
identify the appropriate locations for setting up collection points
set up an appropriate number of collection points to facilitate efficient collection of produce
collect the produce from different collection points through effective coordination
ensure correct weighing/counting of the produce with the help of appropriate tools and equipment
collect the stock from the common storage for transportation
ensure appropriate handling of the produce with adherence to the established quality assurance processes
ensure on-time delivery of produce to the target markets and buyers, with no damage during transportation

modules.module_title: Identify and negotiate with the input sellers/service providers

pcs.pc_description: collect information about the relevant input sellers and service providers by referring to reliable sources
determine the pricing schedule of the identified input sellers and service providers
shortlist appropriate input sellers/service providers
carry out negotiations with the shortlisted vendors to secure a profitable price for the required inputs and services
contribute to bulk purchase of seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides at reduced costs
select the appropriate vendor(s) as per the budget and organizational criteria
carry out appropriate documentation to enter into an agreement with the input sellers/ service providers for the timely supply of quality inputs/services
maintain shared records of input distribution and usage
analyze the existing trade system and trade environment
identify and shortlist the prospective buyers
determine the stock requirement of the buyers, including the choice, by coordinating with them
conduct demand planning to project the future demand for the produce and customize the output
coordinate with the relevant personnel to make decision on what and how much to produce based on the demand

pcs.pc_description: negotiate the price of agricultural produce with the buyers
carry out relevant documentation with the buyers to enter into an agreement with them
ensure the receipt of timely payments from buyers as per the agreed terms and conditions
maintain regular communication with the buyers to promptly resolve any issues experienced by them
ensure a match between the demand and supply with the continuity of supply as per the agreed terms
ensure proper weight measurement of the produce before being supplied to buyers
coordinate the logistics and timely supply of produce to the buyers
maintain transparency in the flow of goods with the use of tracking systems
provide accurate information on logistics and quality of produce to buyers
